svg.title: Croissant Baking — SPPM
svg.desc: SPPM diagram for Croissant Baking. Read node and transition labels for process details.

g.text: Fold and roll dough to create layers.
Place dough in controlled climate to rise.
Clean oven from previous batch, set
Place trays in oven, monitor baking.
Cool on racks, package for delivery.

Oven changeover (setup, 30 min) is different from waiting for oven availability (queue, 120 min). Reducing oven setup via SMED does NOT fix waiting-for-oven. Pull systems or additional ovens fix the queue, not setup optimization.
